items.title: 68252_Jay Cee
items.q: Johnny Burke, all of them, we all congregated at Will Wontillis' at 1600 Broadway, every day.

ctx.x: That's one of the darndest frustrations for a person to have, who is writing that particular, I'd say, form for a living --and at one time, that was all I had to do, to write. Because I can tell you the time -- at 1600 Broadway, when a very, very fine friend who went on to bigger things -- Frank Lesser -- and all the big groups, Johnny Burke, all of them, we all congregated at Will Wontillis' at 1600 Broadway, every day. All the songwriters were there trashing around, well, what did you do yesterday? Did you get…

But we all got together and thrashed out what was done the day before, and a lot of times, it would help a lot of writers, you see. So Mr. Gys and Dolls, he was there, just an ordinary guy like we were, until he hit the bucket up there, and when that came, he was gone - he was on his own. When Johnny Burke hit it, he was gone.
